questions.prompt: What is the primary form of this content?
questions.instructions: Select exactly one form that best describes the main document structure. If none match clearly or the content is mixed/unclear, select 'other'.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about artificial intelligence, machine learning, or neural models?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if AI, ML, LLMs, or related technologies are a primary focus. Answer No if AI is only briefly mentioned as an analogy or passing reference.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about local models, on-device AI, self-hosted inference, or private local workflows?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if the content specifically addresses running models locally, local hardware, llama.cpp, Ollama, local weights, or on-device evaluation. Answer No if it only discusses cloud API models.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about software development, coding tools, engineering practices, or programming languages?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if software architecture, source code, developer tooling, or programming practices are a central subject.

questions.prompt: Does this content contain empirical benchmarks, quantitative performance metrics, or systematic test results?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if specific numerical benchmarks, latency/throughput metrics, accuracy tables, or experimental comparisons are provided.

questions.prompt: Does this content reflect direct, first-hand practitioner experience, troubleshooting, or implementation results?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if the author describes direct personal usage, debugging, building, or observing actual behavior rather than merely summarizing third-party news or press releases.

questions.prompt: Is this content structured as a step-by-step how-to, recipe, tutorial, or setup guide?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if it provides actionable instructions for reproducing a setup, building an application, or configuring an environment.

questions.prompt: Does this content highlight critical pitfalls, security risks, post-mortems, or warnings?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if the primary value is highlighting failure modes, security hazards, caveats, or lessons learned.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about LLM agents, multi-agent frameworks, tool use, or autonomous AI systems?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if agent loops, tool calling, autonomous workflows, or agentic architectures are a primary subject.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about developer tooling, compilers, package managers, IDEs, or CLI utilities?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if developer workflows, editors, build systems, terminals, package managers, or developer utilities are central.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about Apple Silicon architecture, unified memory, Metal, or Mac hardware performance?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if M-series architecture, Mac hardware benchmarks, MLX on Apple chips, or Apple-specific hardware engineering are featured.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about data privacy, encryption, local-first computing, or digital sovereignty?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if user privacy, cryptography, local data ownership, telemetry blocking, or surveillance resistance are a central theme.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about writing craft, essay composition, note-taking methods, or knowledge organization?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if writing technique, research synthesis, note systems (Zettelkasten/PKM), or essay structure are central.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about the electric power grid, power transmission, utility rates, or energy capacity?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if electrical grids (PJM, ERCOT, etc.), power reliability, data center energy demand, substations, or electricity pricing are primary subjects.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about economic policy, utility regulation, public finance, or municipal subsidies?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if public utility commissions, tax abatements, municipal revenue, tariff design, or economic regulatory policies are central.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about Austrian economics, sound money, spontaneous order, or market cycle theory?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if Austrian school principles (Mises, Hayek, Rothbard), monetary debasement, capital theory, or market price discovery are explored.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about Bitcoin, proof-of-work, cryptographic money, or decentralized protocols?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if Bitcoin architecture, mining, Lightning Network, UTXO model, self-custody, or BTC monetary properties are central.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about operating systems, kernels, low-level systems programming, or Unix internals?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if OS architecture, Linux/BSD kernels, memory allocators, filesystems, eBPF, system calls, or low-level systems engineering are primary subjects.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about video games, game engine tech, game design theory, or retro computing?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if game development, graphics engines, physics, game mechanics, retro hardware, or playable interactive simulations are central.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about philosophy, epistemology, ethics, philosophy of mind, or rationality?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if epistemological questions, moral reasoning, philosophy of mind, rationalist discourse, or intellectual history are central.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about political commentary, institutional analysis, civic governance, or political economy?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if civic debates, institutional structure, freedom of expression, state capacity, or political commentary are the main subject.

questions.prompt: Is this content substantially about creative technology, novel computational art, ingenious experiments, or cool tech demos?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if generative art, novel UI experiments, demoscene, hardware hacks, creative AI mashups, or playful computing are featured.

questions.prompt: Does this content present an in-depth field report, production retrospective, or real-world deployment account?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if the author shares lessons learned from real-world, production, or field deployments rather than toy examples.

questions.prompt: Does this content present a reasoned thesis, persuasive argument, or structured debate point defending a claim?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if the text systematically defends a specific thesis, critiques counterarguments, or presents philosophical/economic premises.

questions.prompt: Is this content a project launch, version release announcement, or product rollout?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if the piece is primarily announcing a new software release, launch, changelog, or availability.

questions.prompt: Does this content showcase an impressive, creative, or novel project, demo, build, or open-source tool?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if it features an inspiring personal build, open-source project, creative tech demo, or novel engineering feat.

questions.prompt: Is this content a primary data source, curated dataset, reference table, or statistical archive?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if it provides raw data tables, downloadable datasets, structured statistical collections, or public record archives.

questions.prompt: Score the depth of concrete empirical or technical evidence provided.
questions.instructions: 1: Minimal or surface mention without substantiation; 2: Moderate supporting evidence, code snippets, or summarized data; 3: Rigorous data, reproducible methodology, detailed logs, or complete runnable artifacts.

questions.prompt: Does this source content directly and factually substantiate the stated claim?
questions.instructions: Answer Yes if the text contains clear evidence, empirical data, or explicit statements directly supporting the claim. Answer No if the claim is contradicted, unsupported, or only tangentially related.
